name: Community Transport South Australia
shortDescription: Transport assistance for South Australians who cannot drive, obtain help from another driver or use suitable public transport.
plainEnglishSummary: If transport difficulties prevent you from attending appointments, shopping, joining community activities or going to a job interview, Community Transport South Australia may help you find or arrange suitable transport.
audience: South Australians under 65 experiencing transport disadvantage
People unable to drive themselves or ask someone else to drive them
People unable to use public transport because of distance, mobility, cost or limited service availability
People aged 65 or over who are registered with My Aged Care
supportTypes: Transport in a car with a worker or volunteer
Transport to shops and community facilities
availabilityNote: Fees may apply. Availability, booking requirements and service coverage depend on the Community Transport SA provider operating in the user's region.
eligibilityNote: Community Connect cannot confirm eligibility. People under 65 generally need to live in South Australia and experience transport disadvantage. People aged 65 or over generally need to be registered with My Aged Care. Contact the provider in your region to confirm availability, eligibility and fees.
